in_marathi.name: Smitansh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Smitansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from Sanskrit 'smita' (grace, pleasure) and 'ansh' (part, portion). It signifies the grace of a deity or the divine presence bestowed upon an individual.

in_bengali.name: Smitansh
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ God's grace
